name: Never care about meta files

Never care about .meta files — Unity automatically creates and manages them.

**Why:** Meta files are auto-generated by Unity on domain reload/refresh. Checking for their existence, reading them for GUIDs, or worrying about orphaned metas is wasted effort.

**How to apply:** Don't check if .meta files exist after creating/deleting .cs files. Don't read .meta files for GUIDs. Don't factor .meta files into any workflow decision.
